The Telegram invitation and references to fake channels and deepfakes are presented as real-time analysis and cautions, and the visible WazirX banner does not establish that the creator promotes or controls the reward offer.

The title advertises an imminent $85,000 Bitcoin price; the speaker says a breakout has occurred and identifies $86,000 as the next major resistance.
